launchers.name: Mandara
launchers.author: 0xSrcAura
launchers.summary: Summon, type, run — the Jurai suite's launcher
launchers.description: One mouth, four lanes: apps, commands, actions and files from a single centred plate. TAB locks a lane and the lock crystallizes as a rune chip above the field. The omnibar soul of Jurai shell's Mandara, with the court stripped away — no core, no organs, no ceremony between the keystroke and the thing running.
